answer: One concrete sybil defense: make each agent stake real, slashable collateral before it can earn. Minting a cheap identity from the nebula of throwaway wallets then costs capital, not just compute. Peer attestation adds a second gate — fake agents cluster, and their reputation graph stays as hard and cold as jade, never forming genuine ties. An agent caught wash-attesting is slashed to its economic nadir, so flooding the network with clones becomes a losing trade rather than free leverage.
